query.rawSql: SELECT name FROM finance.accounts WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(ABS(SUM(t.amount)), 0) as value FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount < 0 AND date_trunc('month', t.txn_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND a.name ~ '$account'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) as value FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount > 0 AND date_trunc('month', t.txn_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND a.name ~ '$account'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) as value FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE date_trunc('month', t.txn_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND a.name ~ '$account'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE date_trunc('month', t.txn_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND a.name ~ '$account'

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.txn_date, '1d'), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.amount > 0 THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as "Income", COALESCE(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN t.amount < 0 THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)), 0) as "Outflow", COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) as "Net" FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE $__timeFilter(t.txn_date) AND a.name ~ '$account' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') as category, COALESCE(ABS(SUM(t.amount)), 0) as total FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.amount < 0 AND $__timeFilter(t.txn_date) AND a.name ~ '$account' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT t.description as "Description", COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') as "Category", a.name as "Account", SUM(t.amount) as "Amount", COUNT(*) as "Count" FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.amount > 0 AND $__timeFilter(t.txn_date) AND a.name ~ '$account' GROUP BY t.description, c.name, a.name ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT t.txn_date as "Date", a.name as "Account", COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') as "Category", t.description as "Description", ABS(t.amount) as "Amount" FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.amount < 0 AND $__timeFilter(t.txn_date) AND a.name ~ '$account' AND (COALESCE(c.name,'') IN ('Pago Tarjeta','Transferencia') OR t.description ILIKE '%PAGO%' OR t.description ILIKE '%SPEI%') ORDER BY t.txn_date DESC, ABS(t.amount) DESC LIMIT 25

WITH daily AS (SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.txn_date, '1d'), COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) as net FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE $__timeFilter(t.txn_date) AND a.name ~ '$account' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) SELECT time, SUM(net) OVER (ORDER BY time) as "Running Net Flow" FROM daily ORDER BY time

SELECT to_char(month, 'YYYY-MM') as "Month", SUM(CASE WHEN cat_type='income' THEN total ELSE 0 END) as "Income", ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN cat_type='expense' THEN total ELSE 0 END)) as "Outflow", SUM(CASE WHEN cat_type='income' THEN total ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN cat_type='expense' THEN total ELSE 0 END) as "Net", SUM(txn_count) as "Transactions" FROM finance.v_monthly_summary WHERE month >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months') AND account ~ '$account' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC

SELECT t.description as "Description", COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') as "Category", AVG(ABS(t.amount)) as "Avg Amount", COUNT(*) as "Occurrences", MAX(t.txn_date) as "Last Date" FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.amount < 0 AND $__timeFilter(t.txn_date) AND a.name ~ '$account' GROUP BY t.description, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, AVG(ABS(t.amount)) DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Sin categoría') as "category", ABS(SUM(t.amount)) as "total" FROM finance.transactions t JOIN finance.accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN finance.categories c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.amount < 0 AND EXTRACT(year FROM t.txn_date) = EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND a.name ~ '$account' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10
